description: MSAL4J Persistence Extension implements the ITokenCacheAccessAspect interface from the Microsoft Authentication Library for Java (MSAL4J) so applications can persist their token cache to platform-specific secure storage. It encrypts the cache with DPAPI on Windows, stores it in Keychain on macOS, and uses the Secret Service API (via libsecret) on Linux, relying on JNA to call the native platform APIs.
